struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    
    string toString() {
        ostringstream oss;
        oss << "(" << x << ", " << y << ")";
        return oss.str();
    }
    
    Point line(Point other) {
        if (abs(x - other.x) <= EPS && abs(y - other.y) <= EPS) return Point(0, 0);
        double a = other.y - y;
        double b = x - other.x;
        double c = -a * x - b * y;
        return Point(a, b, c);
    }
    
    bool equals(Point other) {
        return abs(x - other.x) <= EPS && abs(y - other.y) <= EPS;

        double dx = x - other.x;
        double dy = y - other.y;
        return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    }
    
    double distance(Line line) {
        return abs(line.a * x + line.b * y + line.c);
    }
    
    double value() {
        return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    }
    
    double angle() {
        return atan2(y, x);
    }
    
    Point rotate(double angle) {
        double nx = x * cos(angle) - y * sin(angle);
        double ny = y * cos(angle) + x * sin(angle);
        return Point(nx, ny);
    }
};

struct Line {
    double a, b, c;
    Line() : a(0), b(0), c(0) {}
    Line(Point p, double angle) {
        a = sin(angle);
        b = -cos(angle);
        c = -p.x * a - p.y * b;
    }
    Line(double a, double b, double c) {
        double h = sqrt(a * a + b * b);
        this->a = a / h;
        this->b = b / h;
        this->c = c / h;
    }
    
    Point intersect(Line other) {
        if (parallel(other)) return Point(0, 0);
        double determinant = b * other.a - a * other.b;
        double x = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / determinant;
        double y = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / determinant;
        return Point(x, y);
    }
    
    bool parallel(Line other) {
        return abs(a * other.b - b * other.a) < EPS;
    }
    
    bool contains(Point point) {
        return abs(value(point)) < EPS;
    }
    
    Line perpendicular(Point point) {
        return Line(-b, a, b * point.x - a * point.y);
    }
    
    double value(Point point) {
        return a * point.x + b * point.y + c;
    }
    
    double distance(Point center) {
        return abs(value(center));
    }
    
    bool equals(Line other) {
        if (!parallel(other)) return false;
        if (abs(a * other.c - c * other.a) > EPS || abs(b * other.c - c * other.b) > EPS) return false;
        return true;
    }
};

struct Segment {
    Point a, b;
    double distance;
    Line* line_ptr;
    
    Segment() : distance(NAN), line_ptr(nullptr) {}
    Segment(Point a, Point b) : a(a), b(b), distance(NAN), line_ptr(nullptr) {}
    
    double length() {
        if (isnan(distance)) distance = a.distance(b);
        return distance;
    }
    
    double distance(Point point) {
        double len = length();
        double left = point.distance(a);
        if (len < EPS) return left;
        double right = point.distance(b);
        if (left * left > right * right + len * len) return right;
        if (right * right > left * left + len * len) return left;
        return point.distance(line());
    }
    
    Point intersect(Segment other, bool includeEnds) {
        Line line = line();
        Line otherLine = other.a.line(other.b);
        if (line.parallel(otherLine)) return Point(0, 0);
        Point intersection = line.intersect(otherLine);
        if (contains(intersection, includeEnds) && other.contains(intersection, includeEnds)) return intersection;
        else return Point(0, 0);
    }
    
    bool contains(Point point, bool includeEnds) {
        if (a.equals(point) || b.equals(point)) return includeEnds;
        if (a.equals(b)) return false;
        Line line = line();
        if (!line.contains(point)) return false;
        Line perpendicular = line.perpendicular(a);
        double aValue = perpendicular.value(a);
        double bValue = perpendicular.value(b);
        double pointValue = perpendicular.value(point);
        return (aValue < pointValue && pointValue < bValue) || (bValue < pointValue && pointValue < aValue);
    }
    
    Line line() {
        if (line_ptr == nullptr) {
            line_ptr = new Line(a.line(b));
        }
        return *line_ptr;
    }
    
    Point middle() {
        return Point((a.x + b.x) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2);
    }
    
    Point intersect(Line line) {
        Line selfLine = line();
        Point intersect = selfLine.intersect(line);
        if (intersect.x == 0 && intersect.y == 0) return Point(0, 0);
        if (contains(intersect, true)) return intersect;
        return Point(0, 0);
    }
    
    double distance(Segment other) {
        Line line = line();
        Line otherLine = other.line();
        Point p = (line.a == 0 && line.b == 0) || (otherLine.a == 0 && otherLine.b == 0) ? Point(0, 0) : line.intersect(otherLine);
        if (p.x != 0 || p.y != 0) {
            if (contains(p, true) && other.contains(p, true)) return 0;
        }
        return min(min(other.distance(a), other.distance(b)), min(distance(other.a), distance(other.b)));
    }
};

struct Polygon {
    vector<Point> vertices;
    vector<Segment> sides;
    
    Polygon(vector<Point> vertices) : vertices(vertices) {}
    
    double square() {
        double sum = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < vertices.size(); i++)
            sum += (vertices[i].x - vertices[i - 1].x) * (vertices[i].y + vertices[i - 1].y);
        sum += (vertices[0].x - vertices[vertices.size() - 1].x) * (vertices[0].y + vertices[vertices.size() - 1].y);
        return abs(sum) / 2;
    }
    
    Point center() {
        double sx = 0, sy = 0;
        for (Point point : vertices) {
            sx += point.x;
            sy += point.y;
        }
        return Point(sx / vertices.size(), sy / vertices.size());
    }
    
    bool contains(Point point) {
        return contains(point, false);
    }
    
    bool contains(Point point, bool strict) {
        for (Segment segment : sides()) {
            if (segment.contains(point, true)) return !strict;
        }
        double totalAngle = canonicalAngle(atan2(vertices[0].y - point.y, vertices[0].x - point.x) - atan2(vertices[vertices.size() - 1].y - point.y, vertices[vertices.size() - 1].x - point.x));
        for (int i = 1; i < vertices.size(); i++) {
            totalAngle += canonicalAngle(atan2(vertices[i].y - point.y, vertices[i].x - point.x) - atan2(vertices[i - 1].y - point.y, vertices[i - 1].x - point.x));
        }
        return abs(totalAngle) > M_PI;
    }
    
    vector<Segment> sides() {
        if (sides.empty()) {
            sides.resize(vertices.size());
            for (int i = 0; i < vertices.size() - 1; i++) sides[i] = Segment(vertices[i], vertices[i + 1]);
            sides[sides.size() - 1] = Segment(vertices[vertices.size() - 1], vertices[0]);
        }
        return sides;
    }
    
    double perimeter() {
        double result = vertices[0].distance(vertices[vertices.size() - 1]);
        for (int i = 1; i < vertices.size(); i++) result += vertices[i].distance(vertices[i - 1]);
        return result;
    }
};

double canonicalAngle(double angle) {
    while (angle > M_PI) angle -= 2 * M_PI;
    while (angle < -M_PI) angle += 2 * M_PI;
    return angle;
}

double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
    return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
}

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& stream;
    char buf[1024];
    int curChar;
    int numChars;
    
public:
    InputReader(istream& stream) : stream(stream), curChar(0), numChars(0) {}
    
    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            stream.read(buf, 1024);
            numChars = stream.gcount();
            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }
    
    int peek() {
        if (numChars == -1) return -1;
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            stream.read(buf, 1024);
            numChars = stream.gcount();
            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar];
    }
    
    int readInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (c != -1 && isspace(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (c != -1 && !isspace(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }
    
    long long readLong() {
        int c = read();
        while (c != -1 && isspace(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        long long res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (c != -1 && !isspace(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }
    
    string readString() {
        int c = read();
        while (c != -1 && isspace(c)) c = read();
        string res;
        do {
            if (c != -1) res += (char)c;
            c = read();
        } while (c != -1 && !isspace(c));
        return res;
    }
    
    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return isspace(c);
    }
    
    string readLine0() {
        string buf;
        int c = read();
        while (c != '\n' && c != -1) {
            if (c != '\r') buf += (char)c;
            c = read();
        }
        return buf;
    }
    
    string readLine() {
        string s = readLine0();
        while (s.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n") == string::npos) s = readLine0();
        return s;
    }
    
    string readLine(bool ignoreEmptyLines) {
        if (ignoreEmptyLines) return readLine();
        else return readLine0();
    }
    
    char readCharacter() {
        int c = read();
        while (c != -1 && isspace(c)) c = read();
        return (char)c;
    }
    
    double readDouble() {
        int c = read();
        while (c != -1 && isspace(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        double res = 0;
        while (c != -1 && !isspace(c) && c != '.') {
            if (c == 'e' || c == 'E') return res * pow(10, readInt());
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        }
        if (c == '.') {
            c = read();
            double m = 1;
            while (c != -1 && !isspace(c)) {
                if (c == 'e' || c == 'E') return res * pow(10, readInt());
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
                m /= 10;
                res += (c - '0') * m;
                c = read();
            }

        return res * sgn;
    }
    
    bool isExhausted() {
        int value;
        while (isSpaceChar(value = peek()) && value != -1) read();
        return value == -1;
    }
    
    string next() {
        return readString();
    }

class IOUtils {
public:
    static vector<int> readIntArray(InputReader& in, int size) {
        vector<int> array(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) array[i] = in.readInt();
        return array;
    }
    
    static vector<long long> readLongArray(InputReader& in, int size) {
        vector<long long> array(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) array[i] = in.readLong();
        return array;
    }
    
    static void readLongArrays(InputReader& in, vector<long long>&... arrays) {
        int size = 0;
        // Assuming all arrays have the same size
        ((size = arrays.size()), ...);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int idx = 0;
            ((arrays[i] = in.readLong(), ++idx), ...);
        }
    }
};

class Task {
public:
    virtual void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) = 0;
    virtual ~Task() = default;
};

class TaskA : public Task {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) override {
        int n = in.readInt(), a = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a ^= i;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) a ^= in.readInt();
        out.printLine(a);
    }
};

class TaskB : public Task {
private:
    vector<int> arr;
    queue<pii> mais, menos;
    
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) override {
        int n = in.readInt();
        long long ret = 0LL, c = 0LL;
        arr = IOUtils::readIntArray(in, n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) c += arr[i];
        c /= n;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (arr[i] < c) menos.push({(int)c - arr[i], i});
            else mais.push({arr[i] - (int)c, i});
        }
        while (!mais.empty() && !menos.empty()) {
            int x = mais.front().first, y = menos.front().first, d = abs(mais.front().second - menos.front().second);
            ret += 1LL * min(x, y) * d;
            if (x == y) {
                mais.pop();
                menos.pop();
            } else if (x < y) {
                mais.pop();
                menos.pop();
                menos.push({y - x, menos.front().second});
            } else {
                mais.pop();
                mais.push({x - y, mais.front().second});
                menos.pop();
            }
        }
        out.printLine(ret);
    }
};

class TaskC : public Task {
private:
    vector<long long> pow;
    
public:
    TaskC() : pow(16, 0) {}
    
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) override {
        pow[0] = 1LL;
        for (int i = 1; i < 16; i++) pow[i] = 10LL * pow[i-1] + 1LL;
        out.printLine(f(in.readLong()));
    }
    
    int f(long long n) {
        if (n <= 1LL) return (int)n;
        int pos = 15, x = 0;
        for (; pos >= 0 && pow[pos] >= n; pos--);
        pos++;
        long long m1 = 0LL, m2 = pow[pos];
        int x1 = 0, x2 = pos + 1;
        while (m1 + pow[pos-1] <= n) {
            m1 += pow[pos-1];
            x1 += pos;
        }
        while (m2 - pow[pos-1] >= n) {
            m2 -= pow[pos-1];
            x2 += pos;
        }
        x1 += f(n - m1);
        x2 += f(m2 - n);
        return min(x1, x2);
    }
};

class TaskD : public Task {
private:
    vector<edge> edges;
    vector<int> pai, tam;
    
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) override {
        int n = in.readInt(), m = in.readInt();
        vector<int> a = IOUtils::readIntArray(in, n);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = in.readInt() - 1, y = in.readInt() - 1;
            edges.push_back({min(a[x], a[y]), {x, y}});
        }
        pai.resize(n);
        tam.resize(n);
        sort(edges.begin(), edges.end(), greater<edge>());
        out.printLine(2.0 * kruskal(n) / n / (n - 1));
    }
    
    long long kruskal(int n) {
        long long ret = 0LL;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) pai[i] = i;
        fill(tam.begin(), tam.end(), 1);
        for (auto& par : edges) {
            int w = par.first, x = par.second.first, y = par.second.second;
            if (find(x) != find(y)) {
                ret += 1LL * w * tam[find(x)] * tam[find(y)];
                if (tam[find(x)] < tam[find(y)]) {
                    tam[find(y)] += tam[find(x)];
                    pai[find(x)] = find(y);
                } else {
                    tam[find(x)] += tam[find(y)];
                    pai[find(y)] = find(x);
                }
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    
    int find(int x) {
        if (x == pai[x]) return x;
        return pai[x] = find(pai[x]);
    }
};

class TaskE : public Task {
private:
    vector<long long> x, y;
    vector<vector<long long>> dp;
    long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
    Polygon polygon;
    vector<Point> points;
    
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) override {
        int n = in.readInt();
        x.resize(n);
        y.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) x[i] = in.readLong();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) y[i] = in.readLong();
        points.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) points[i] = Point(x[i], y[i]);
        polygon = Polygon(points);
        dp.assign(n, vector<long long>(n, -1LL));
        out.printLine(dp(0, n - 1));
    }
    
    long long dp(int i, int j) {
        if (dp[i][j] != -1LL) return dp[i][j];
        if (j == i + 1) return dp[i][j] = 1LL;
        dp[i][j] = 0LL;
        Segment segment = Segment(points[i], points[j]);
        for (Point point : polygon.vertices) if (segment.contains(point, false)) return dp[i][j];
        for (int k = 0; k < i - 1; k++) if (segment.intersect(Segment(points[k], points[k+1]), true).x != 0 || segment.intersect(Segment(points[k], points[k+1]), true).y != 0) return dp[i][j];
        for (int k = i + 1; k < j - 1; k++) if (segment.intersect(Segment(points[k], points[k+1]), true).x != 0 || segment.intersect(Segment(points[k], points[k+1]), true).y != 0) return dp[i][j];
        for (int k = j + 1; k < points.size() - 1; k++) if (segment.intersect(Segment(points[k], points[k+1]), true).x != 0 || segment.intersect(Segment(points[k], points[k+1]), true).y != 0) return dp[i][j];
        if (i != 0 && j != 0 && i != points.size() - 1 && j != points.size() - 1) 
            if (segment.intersect(Segment(points[0], points[points.size()-1]), true).x != 0 || segment.intersect(Segment(points[0], points[points.size()-1]), true).y != 0) return dp[i][j];
        Point middle = Point(0.5 * (points[i].x + points[j].x), 0.5 * (points[i].y + points[j].y));
        if (!polygon.contains(middle)) return dp[i][j] = 0LL;
        for (int k = i + 1; k < j; k++) dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp(i, k) * dp(k, j) % MOD) % MOD;
        return dp[i][j];
    }
};
